description: Governor's Office Western Province - The Inquiry being Conducted under Sec. 184 (1A) of the Urban Councils Ordinance read with Sec. 2 of the Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act No. 12 of 1989
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the extension of an investigation being conducted by a judicial inquiry board (comprised of a retired Judge of the Court of Appeal) into potential offenses committed by a local government body and its chairman. The content deals with a law enforcement and judicial process, specifically an inquiry under the Urban Councils Ordinance, which falls under the Judicial/Law Enforcement category.
